purpose: Existing pure V8 byte verification helpers retained for artifact transfer when the local workspace is unavailable; no host/native execution.
usage: Evaluate each function declaration in parentheses. Bind utf and sha1 before the text Git-blob helper. For binary Git hashing concatenate utf('blob '+bytes.length+'\0') and the decoded bytes, then sha1 the result. Require exact expected length, SHA256 and Git blob from the original export before upload.
